title: Evidence Recomposition and Predictive Context Residualization for Visual Attribution in Multimodal Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2509.22415v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved strong vision-language performance, yet their token-level visual evidence remains difficult to inspect. Recent logit-lens attribution methods project each visual-token hidden state into the vocabulary space to explain generated words, but this token-wise readout introduces a mismatch: visual tokens are context-mixed by the model, while the attribution score is decoded independently at each token location. This often produces fragmented attribution maps and can be further affected by autoregressive context signals from preceding text tokens. We propose ERCR, an attribution framework built from Evidence Recomposition (ER) and Predictive Context Residualization (PCR). translated_title: 多模态大语言模型中视觉归因的证据重组与预测上下文残差化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2509.22415v5 公告类型：交叉替换  摘要：多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在视觉-语言任务中表现出色，但其令牌级别的视觉证据仍难以检查。最近的logit-lens归因方法将每个视觉令牌的隐藏状态投影到词汇空间以解释生成的词语，但这种逐令牌读取引入了不匹配：视觉令牌被模型进行上下文混合，而归因分数在每个令牌位置独立解码。这常常导致碎片化的归因图，并可能受到来自前序文本令牌的自回归上下文信号的影响。我们提出ERCR，一个基于证据重组（ER）和预测上下文残差化（PCR）构建的归因框架。ER通过多个视图（具有不同的令牌到区域分配）聚合目标证据，减少了由单一读取网格引起的归因碎片化。PCR估计前序令牌上下文图，以消除其干扰。
tldr: 本文提出ERCR框架，通过证据重组减少归因碎片化，并用预测上下文残差化消除前序文本干扰，从而提升多模态大语言模型的视觉归因准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the ERCR framework, which reduces attribution fragmentation via evidence recomposition and removes preceding-text interference via predictive context residualization, improving visual attribution accuracy in multimodal large language models.
